verses.text: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: The one who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars says this: I know what you do. You have a reputation for being alive, but you’re dead.
Wake up! Strengthen what remains and is about to die, because I haven’t found your deeds complete in God’s sight.
Remember what you received and heard. Keep it and turn back. If you don’t wake up, I’ll come like a thief, and you won’t know when I’ll come.
But you have a few people in Sardis who haven’t stained their clothes. They’ll walk with me in white, because they’re worthy.
The one who conquers will be dressed in white. I’ll never erase their name from the book of life, but will acknowledge them before my Father and his angels.
Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
“To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: The Holy One, the True One, who holds the key of David—what he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open—says this:
I know what you do. Look, I’ve placed an open door in front of you that no one can shut. I know you have little strength, yet you’ve kept my word and haven’t denied my name.
I’ll make those from Satan’s synagogue, who claim to be Jews but aren’t and are lying, come and bow at your feet. They’ll know that I’ve loved you.
Because you’ve kept my command to endure patiently, I’ll keep you from the time of testing that’s coming on the whole world to test those who live on earth.
I’m coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so no one takes your crown.

The one who conquers I’ll make a pillar in the temple of my God, and they’ll never leave it. I’ll write on them the name of my God, the name of God’s city—the new Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from my God—and my new name.
Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
“To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: The Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of God’s creation, says this:
I know what you do. You’re neither cold nor hot. I wish you were one or the other!
So because you’re lukewarm—not hot or cold—I’m about to spit you out of my mouth.
You say, ‘I’m rich. I’ve become wealthy and don’t need anything.’ But you don’t realize you’re wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
I advise you to buy from me gold refined by fire so you can become rich; white clothes to wear so your shameful nakedness won’t be exposed; and medicine to put on your eyes so you can see.
I correct and discipline everyone I love. So be earnest and turn back.
Look, I’m standing at the door and knocking. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I’ll come in and eat with them, and they with me.
To the one who conquers, I’ll give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I conquered and sat down with my Father on his throne.
Anyone with ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.”
